The cluster prefix tenant partition section (head ~3096-3117) is unchanged context that matches the threat model's account/tenant scoping. The CI runner label isolation described is outside the provider threat-model scope, which covers the provider and native runtime. There is no concrete security regression. The remaining open question is whether the actual CI route and label code matches the documented isolation, which is outside this docs-only diff.
